title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Named destinations along the Park Avenue, Dartmouth Avenue, and South Chester Road corridors beside Swarthmore College.

cards.title: Swarthmore Public Library
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue corridor — 121 Park Ave
cards.notes: Use the Park Avenue corridor to reach the borough library at 121 Park Avenue; check its calendar or services before planning a longer stop.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed public library in the town-center civic block.
cards.evidence_claim: The Borough's 2026 Town Center Merchant Map lists the Public Library at 121 Park Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Public library; consult the library or Borough for current service hours.

cards.title: Central Park and Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue corridor — beside 121 Park Ave
cards.notes: Walk the Park Avenue corridor to the borough's Central Park and Amphitheater, then look for the town's scheduled concerts, markets, or performances.
cards.short_summary: A civic outdoor venue used for town-center events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Borough identifies Central Park and its amphitheater as a site for farmers markets, concerts, and performances.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor programming varies; confirm event details with the Borough or organizer.

cards.title: Swarthmore Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue corridor — Borough lot at 121 Park Ave
cards.notes: Head to the Borough parking lot from Park Avenue when the market is scheduled; use the organizer's information to confirm the season and vendors.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled market at the town-center municipal lot.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore Town Center states that the farmers market is located in the Borough parking lot at 121 Park Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal event; verify the current market date before going.

cards.title: Hobbs Coffee
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue corridor — 1 Park Ave
cards.notes: Follow Park Avenue to Hobbs Coffee at 1 Park Avenue if you want a named café stop; check the business directly for current offerings and hours.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed café at the start of Park Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Borough's 2026 Town Center Merchant Map lists Hobbs Coffee at 1 Park Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Food and drink purchases may be required.

cards.title: Luna's Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue corridor — 6 Park Ave
cards.notes: Use Park Avenue to find Luna's Mexican Grill at 6 Park Avenue; consult the restaurant before visiting for its current menu and service details.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant on the compact Park Avenue commercial block.
cards.evidence_claim: The Borough's Where to Eat page lists Luna's Mexican Grill at 6 Park Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant visit; food purchase is required to dine.

cards.title: Renato Pizza
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue corridor — 8 Park Ave
cards.notes: Continue along Park Avenue to Renato Pizza at 8 Park Avenue for a clearly identified local dining stop; verify current service information directly.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed pizza restaurant along Park Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore College's local dining page lists Renato Pizza at 8 Park Avenue in Swarthmore.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant visit; food purchase is required to dine.

cards.title: Pastry Pants Bakery
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue corridor — 10 Park Ave
cards.notes: Walk the Park Avenue corridor to Pastry Pants Bakery at 10 Park Avenue; confirm the current menu and operating details directly before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A named bakery on Park Avenue's town-center block.
cards.evidence_claim: The Borough's Where to Eat page lists Pastry Pants at 10 Park Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Bakery purchases are required for food items.

cards.title: Celia Bookshop
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue corridor — 102 Park Ave
cards.notes: Use the Park Avenue corridor to locate Celia Bookshop at 102 Park Avenue, then browse its current selection or check with the shop for details.
cards.short_summary: A named bookshop in the Park Avenue commercial corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore Town Center's business directory lists Celia Bookshop at 102 Park Avenue.

cards.title: Swarthmore Co-op
cards.subtitle: Dartmouth Avenue corridor — 341 Dartmouth Ave
cards.notes: Take Dartmouth Avenue to the Swarthmore Co-op at 341 Dartmouth Avenue for a named grocery stop; check the co-op directly for current store information.
cards.short_summary: A community food market on the Dartmouth Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore College's local dining page lists the Swarthmore Co-op at 341 Dartmouth Avenue.

cards.title: Park Avenue Community Center
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue corridor — 129 Park Ave
cards.notes: Continue on Park Avenue to the PAC Center at 129 Park Avenue and look for its current community programs, classes, or scheduled activities.
cards.short_summary: A named community-program location at the end of Park Avenue's civic block.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore Town Center's business directory lists the Park Avenue Community Center at 129 Park Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Programs and any associated fees vary; check the center's current schedule.
